description: Extract representative alchemy bubble bonuses for testing the Bubble bonus root

extractions.label: daily_drip_final_bonus
extractions.expression: (() => { const raw = Number(idleon.getDNSM("AlchBubbles").h.LqdCap); const alchemyLevel = Number(idleon.getAttr("PixelHelperActor")[5].behaviors.getBehavior("ActorEvents_232")._GenINFO[87]); return raw * Math.max(Math.pow(alchemyLevel / 25, 0.3), 0); })()
extractions.description: Da Daily Drip effective final bubble bonus (AlchBubbles.LqdCap × ActorEvents_232._GenINFO[87])
